fair_value_reference_definition: REALITY_MARK: latest completed eligible hourly Reality candle close strictly before scheduled native open minus 60 minutes; price proxy, not learned model or executable quote

label_policy.description: NOISE for sub-floor R or O or opposing signs; otherwise O/R within bounds DISCOVERY, above upper UNDERREACTION, below lower OVERSHOOT. The 0.25 factor is an ex-ante resolution convention relative to the fit-only median, not a tuned cutoff. Equal bounds are DISCOVERY. Labels are retrospective and use next open solely as outcome.

availability: Historical archived price availability and revisions unknown; event-time proxies are not certified as-known features
final_oos_guard: No final OOS entry point; bounds validated before private archive read
